conventions: Distributive אִישׁ is rendered every one and aligned as one unit on the noun headed on one, with every named as the competing head (4.15, 4.18, 4.22, 4.23). The reciprocal אִישׁ ... אָחִיו of 4.19 gives one to אִישׁ, another to אָח and leaves the suffix unrepresented. Where the ASV writes every one and no אִישׁ stands in the Hebrew (4.17) the pair is one added unit headed on one.

The infinitive absolute הַרְבֵּה is read by its syntactic office: adverbial beside a finite verb it takes the degree word alone (4.1 great, beside took indignation); as the predicate of a verbless clause it takes the construction's copula and presentative frame (4.10 there is much, 4.19 is great).
report: Read all 23 verses end to end, including every added unit, against the 56-lemma candidate table. No construction is analysed two ways without the source or the printed ASV licensing the difference.

Waw: every rendered connective (But, Now, So, for, then, that, so that, seeing, with, nor, Therefore) is read off the ASV; the four unrepresented waws are apodosis waws the ASV opens bare (4.1, 4.12), the waw before an asyndetic clause (4.13 s016) and the waw before an object list (4.16 s019). The two supplied ands (4.7, 4.8) and the so of 4.18 stand where no waw or a waw already spent stands, and are correctly added.

Article: consistent throughout — written the to the article, demonstrative/possessive/relative in the article's place to the article (4.2 these, 4.12 that, 4.14 who, 4.17 his, 4.17/4.18 They that/he that), agreement articles unrepresented under rule 47, rectum articles fronted only where the rectum is anarthrous (4.2) and arthrous elsewhere (4.10, 4.14, 4.19, 4.20, 4.21, 4.23). The הַיּוֹם הַהוּא / הָעֵת הַהִיא pairs (4.16, 4.22) both give the written determiner to the pronoun.

Presentative frame: the that stays with hayah where it precedes the when-clause (4.1, 4.7, 4.12) or where no apodosis waw stands (4.16), and goes to the apodosis waw where it opens the apodosis (4.15) — the three shapes rule 45 distinguishes, applied correctly.

Prepositions silenced by recasting (be before the object of build/bear/hold/sound, dative lamed under was wroth, al under mocked/cover) are uniform; compound prepositions with no lexical noun (le-neged, me-acharey, ad-asher) all head on the opening morpheme per rule 23, and those with a construct noun (lifney, mippeney, be-tokh) on the noun.
BSB disagreements are all convention: unrepresented waws, silenced prepositions and articles, and the lexicalized 1cs suffix of adonai (4.14, rule 57). None is a genuine error.

Verse-level choices that were hedged in their notes (4.4 give up, 4.16 from ... forth, 4.18 had girded, 4.22 second may on hayu) are defensible and each names its competing reading; none is a cross-verse split. No contract promotion or amendment: the chapter taught nothing the contract does not already say.
